blocks.text: The holiday season in Makati officially kicked off on November 11 as Ascott Makati hosted an intimate tree lighting ceremony. We were fortunate enough to be part of the celebration, which brought together familiar faces from the media and the hotel industry for an evening that felt less like a corporate event and more like a gathering of old friends. Upon arrival, the lobby buzzed with easy conversation. We spotted several distinguished guests from various media outfits and hospitality stalwarts mingling near the soon to be illuminated tree.
